name: Lugano Airport

runway.v: One runway, 01/19, 1,415 m × 30 m, asphalt (declared distances shorter: 1,305 m and 1,135 m)

hours.v: General aviation daily 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–20:00 local; handling office 07:30–12:00 and 13:30–20:00

curfew.v: No movements outside 07:00–22:00 local. 07:00–08:00, 12:00–13:30 and 20:00–22:00 only with PPR (aircraft over 3 t), asked 48 h ahead and not automatically granted.
curfew.quote: Special Authorization with PPR | from 07.00 to 22.00 LT

ppr.v: PPR by e-mail to the GA handling office at least 48 hours before ETD/ETA for operations outside normal hours
ppr.quote: Minimum 48 hours before ETD/ETA by e-mail to gahandling@luganoairport.ch

permits.v: All IFR and commercial VFR operations need a Lugano-specific qualification for operator and crew, sometimes also aircraft certification
permits.quote: All IFR and commercial VFR procedures require a specific qualification for operators and flight crews members

notes: Read Lugano Airport GA page, airport qualification page and the operator's VFR AD INFO PDF (aerodrome data page dated 25 Mar 2020: older, confirm with current AIP). Swiss AIP (skybriefing) not opened. Short runway in a valley; operator and crew must hold the Lugano qualification. Customs hours not confirmed.
